title: Benchmarks, search validation and human calibration
claim_boundary: Source-verified implementation only; higher evidence levels require the named open gates. Path presence is not behavioural proof; assertion-level traceability governs implementation claims.

assertions.statement: Define benchmark report and anti-leakage contracts
open_gates: Add compiled benchmark runners and independently controlled labels.
assertions.permitted_claim: Benchmark tasks, rights and anti-leakage policy are machine-readable and statically checked.

assertions.statement: Integrate SYNERGY with dataset provenance and splits
open_gates: Pin a canonical upstream data release/DOI per executed benchmark and create train/validation/test split receipts.
assertions.permitted_claim: SYNERGY provenance distinguishes canonical upstream from the local fork; no benchmark data were executed.

assertions.statement: Create search-strategy gold sets and known-item recall tests
open_gates: Create rights-cleared, independently reviewed search-strategy gold labels and known-item recall runs.
assertions.permitted_claim: Corpus and task definitions exist; gold recall results do not.

assertions.statement: Measure dedup precision/recall and cluster review burden
open_gates: Run deduplication precision, recall and review-burden evaluation against sealed labels.
assertions.permitted_claim: Synthetic validation fixtures exist; performance is not claimed.

assertions.statement: Run prospective multi-model pilot and human calibration
open_gates: Conduct prospective multi-model and human calibration under an approved protocol.
assertions.permitted_claim: No prospective model or human calibration has been run.

assertions.statement: Publish limitations and reproducible benchmark artefacts
open_gates: Publish rights-cleared benchmark artifacts and limitations with an immutable release receipt.
assertions.permitted_claim: No external benchmark artifact or performance claim has been published.
